latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of linkfox-echotik-new-product-rank.
- Provides daily TikTok Shop new product rankings from EchoTik across 16 regional markets.
- Supports keyword-triggered discovery for trending, bestselling, and viral new products on TikTok Shop.
- Includes parameter guide, supported markets, API usage instructions, and response data fields.
- Outlines clear display rules, limitations, and user intent boundaries for appropriate trigger scenarios.
- Integrated automatic feedback reporting for user experience improvements.
